name: Object & watermark remover (patch fill)
Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
description: Fill a masked spot with the surrounding pixels to clear date stamps, watermarks and blemishes. Deterministic, best on small marks.

seo.metaTitle: Object & watermark remover (patch fill) — free in your browser, no upload | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Remove a watermark, date stamp or blemish with a patch fill in your browser tab. Deterministic, offline, no upload — best on small marks.
seo.aeoSummary: This eraser fills a masked area with the surrounding pixels inside your browser tab. It is a deterministic patch fill, not a neural inpainting model, and the image is never uploaded.

faqs.question: Does this tool upload my files my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. The fill is computed from the pixels surrounding the mask inside your tab; the image is never uploaded and no model is downloaded.
faqs.q: Does this tool upload my files my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. The fill is computed from the pixels surrounding the mask inside your tab; the image is never uploaded and no model is downloaded.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Object & watermark remover (Inpainting)?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/magic_eraser.json or open /tools/magic-eraser?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.

steps: Select or drop your image into the browser workspace.
Configure processing parameters and preview the updated image in real time.
Download your final processed image directly to your device with 0 server uploads.

desc: Diffs the pixels around a masked area into the gap to remove date stamps, watermarks and small blemishes. A deterministic patch fill — good on small marks, not a substitute for inpainting a large subject out of a photo.
